description: rtlmux reconnect use-after-free regression harness (scripts/native-patches/test_rtlmux_reconnect.py via run-rtlmux-tests.sh). Fake rtl_tcp on loopback; no radio.

scenarios.down: SET_RATE live, then rtl_tcp stopped; 8 SET_FREQ over ~3.6 s across reconnect cycles; no crash; latest freq + rate replayed on the new session; IQ resumes
scenarios.retune: two live retunes forwarded; rtl_tcp restarted; new session receives only the latest freq
scenarios.header: server with bad magic; 6 SET_FREQ while rtlmux drops it; nothing sent to bad sessions; replay once a valid server returns

notes: Unpatched builds fault in serverSendCommand (rtlmux.c:298) -> bufferevent_write on the freed upstream bufferevent; retune is a regression guard and passes on both.
rtlmux binds its stats HTTP listener to "::" with AI_ADDRCONFIG, so test containers need a non-loopback IPv6 address (dedicated IPv6 bridge network). Production uses network_mode: host.
